sentences: We replayed the market's real daily moves from Nov 2024 to Nov 2026 in random 5-day chunks to simulate 5,000 possible years. This shows a range of outcomes, not a forecast.
Typical year: a 45% gain (a $10,000 investment ends near $14,454). For SPY, the market, it's +15%.
Chance of losing more than 10% in a year: 10% (SPY: 6%).
Bad year (5% VaR): in the worst 1 of every 20 simulated years you'd lose at least 21%, about $2,115 on $10,000 (SPY: 11%).
Average of those worst years (5% CVaR): a 31% loss (SPY: 16%).
Your portfolio beat SPY in 82% of the simulated years.
